title: rubus hebecaulis var. agglomeratus
intro: Rubus hebecaulis var. agglomeratus, commonly known as Himalayan raspberry, is a plant species in the Rubus genus. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its reported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan raspberry include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
